name: fashion-store
description: Fashion store on Cloudflare Pages + Workers + D1

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=client & npm run dev --workspace=api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=api
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:api && npm run deploy:pages
scripts.deploy:api: cd api && npm run build && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:pages: cd client && npm run build && cd .. && wrangler pages deploy client/dist --project-name=skvoshop
scripts.deploy:all: npm run build && npm run deploy:api && npm run deploy:pages
scripts.git:push: git branch -M main && git remote add origin https://github.com/SkvoSpace/SkvoShop.git && git push -u origin main
scripts.git:setup: npm run git:init && npm run git:add && npm run git:commit
